prompt: You're reviewing a pull request that changes the merge-at-read logic in a hybrid fan-out feed system: regular authors are fanned out on write into per-follower push timelines, while celebrity/KOL authors are fanned out on read from a salted per-celebrity cache (to spread the hot key across the Redis Cluster and mitigate the celebrity-hotkey problem), and the two sources are merged at read time into one ranked timeline. Walk through the `FeedService` diff below as a senior reviewer: call out every bug you find, explain why it makes the user-visible feed wrong, and rate its severity. The system also has "role drift" — an author can be promoted from regular to KOL over time — so pay close attention to what that does to data written before promotion. For each bug, say how you'd fix it and how you'd test that the fix actually holds.
